title: Beach Eye Medical Group
description: About Beach Eye Medical Group The latest eye-care technology combined with decades of experience makes Beach Eye Medical Group a center of excellence for eye care. ur team of board-certified doctors is led by Dr. Samir Shah, a specialist in complex eye surgery with a sub-specialty in cataract, cornea, and refractive surgery. The company's physician team includes Dr. DruAnn McCluskey, who provides care for a variety of eye conditions, from cornea and external disease to dry eye and glaucoma. Dr. Kevin Jwo specializes in treating cataracts and glaucoma through a variety of medical, laser, and surgical techniques. As a result of the attack on Company Beach Eye Medical Group, more than 200 GB of confidential data was stolen. The data comprises more than 250,000 files containing information about the organization’s employees and their patients, medical records, and doctors reports, as well as other important company information.
